questions.solution_html:

  • Seneca, Protagoras)- 1st to 5th bCE
  • Medieval humanism 5th to 15th BCE
  • Influence of church, revival of classical texts

  • Renaissance humanism- Petrarch- studia humanitatis
  • High renaissance- 16th -17th- politics and art
  • Enlightenment and secular humanism- 17th to 19th- Modern western
  • philosophy
  • Age of reason- 18th century- Voltaire, Rousseau, Kant
  • Humanism and science- 19th century
  • 20th century- Reason and secular ethics- Russell, Sartre.
